checks.note: The short_clips fact reports all seven segments narrated in all three languages, longest narration 33.92 s (zh-Hans segment 6), under the 35 s ceiling; the longest running time is 36.32 s for that same segment, which is the title card and pauses the check allows. The chapter lists in guide-en-desktop.png, guide-es-desktop.png and guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png show seven chapters with per-chapter times from 0:12 to 0:36, no segment missing.

The no_owl fact searched 18 files and found no matches. Nothing owl-like or mascot-like appears in any screenshot: chapter 1 in guide-en-desktop.png, guide-es-desktop.png and guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png is four numbered drawings of a real head and ear, the mastoid dressing, the dressing coming off, the incision behind the ear, and a magnified ear with tape strips.

The narrator fact lists one narrator voice for each of the three narrated languages (en, es, zh-Hans) and no character. The screenshots show no character on screen and no speech bubbles; the spoken line appears as a caption bar and a highlighted transcript sentence, e.g. guide-en-desktop.png and guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png.

The subtitles fact lists captions for segments 1-7 in en, es and zh-Hans. At desktop width the caption bar under the picture is large and legible with the spoken word highlighted, in each language (guide-en-desktop.png "Two days after surgery...", guide-es-desktop.png "Dos dias despues de la cirugia...", guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png), with a Captions / Subtitulos / zimu checkbox. At phone width the transcript under the player carries the same text with the spoken word highlighted, which the check states is the intended caption layout (guide-en-phone.png, guide-es-phone.png, guide-zh-Hans-phone.png). No clipped or overlapping caption text in any of the six.

The toc fact lists all seven chapters and every jump landed exactly on its expected start (0, 12.4, 37.44, 61.92, 77.68, 101.28, 129.36 s) with the right chapter active, and all seven are visible at 1280x800 in each language. The desktop screenshots show the seven numbered chapters with times in a left rail; at phone width the header reads CHAPTER 1 OF 7 / CAPITULO 1 DE 7 with a dropdown and prev/next arrows, so the list is where a patient will find it.

The languages fact shows the Spanish and Mandarin pages carrying their own title, their own audio file, and the expected first sentence in that language, with no error status. The screenshots confirm the whole page turns over, not just the transcript: guide-es-desktop.png and guide-es-phone.png read Idioma, Reproducir, Velocidad, Subtitulos, Imprimir la tarjeta, Llame para pedir ayuda, and the in-picture label Revise si hay cinta; guide-zh-Hans-desktop.png and guide-zh-Hans-phone.png are in Chinese throughout, including the picture label. I found no English left behind in either language.

The provider_file fact records two steps, paste the block and copy the link, 18 ms from paste to link, no account or login fields, and no network requests after load, so the provider stays in the text file with no new app. provider-filled.png shows the four asked-for fields plus language: Antibiotic No, Pain medication Yes, Follow-up 10/01/2026, Language Espanol, each marked From: your block, so the provider's override is read out of the pasted line, and the page says in plain words what the guide will do with each one. provider-draft.png shows the unfilled template with *** placeholders: rather than guess, the page names each line it cannot read and asks the provider to choose, and offers the preset as a one-click option where one exists (Use "about two weeks"); the page also states that a line left out uses its preset. guide-from-link.png confirms the link carries the choice through, opening in Spanish with the transcript showing "Su revision de la herida y examen del oido: 1 de octubre de 2026". One honest gap the page discloses itself: with Antibiotic No the guide says nothing at all about antibiotics, waiting on clinic wording.

The review_line fact shows a single line in the block, "Video guide: language {English/Spanish/Mandarin}    Reviewed by *** on ***", no clinician badge, and no review date in the link. The page tells the truth about it in both provider states: provider-draft.png says "Stays in your note. The patient's guide shows no reviewer line" and provider-filled.png says "Not shown to the patient, and not carried in the link. It stays in your note." guide-from-link-badges.png, scrolled to the end of the transcript of the guide opened from that filled block, shows no reviewer line and no review date.

The card_summary fact reports the card on the first screen at both desktop and phone and the card itself returning 200. The link is one tap and visible without scrolling in every screenshot: Print the card in the header at desktop (guide-en-desktop.png), Imprimir la tarjeta and da yin ka pian in Spanish and Mandarin, and under the player controls at phone width (guide-en-phone.png, guide-es-phone.png, guide-zh-Hans-phone.png).
